The '''"Rider" Ascension Pistol''' was a compact and reliable grappling device produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]]. It replaced modified sidearms with a ready-to-use tool that required no preparation. Its small size allowed easy storage, and its focused design provided greater lift capacity than standard gun modifications. It even allowed the user to carry a passenger, though with some difficulty.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Rider" Ascension Pistol was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
